segs.text: You walked in here for a reason.

Doorway Onset Purpose Loss — D.O.P.L. — strikes nine out of ten adults every single time they change rooms. For decades, sufferers had no choice but to stand in the doorway, retrace their steps... or simply begin a new life in the room they now occupy.
Introducing Thresholdyn. The first once-daily treatment that lets you walk into a room — and still know why.
With Thresholdyn, your purpose crosses the doorway with you.

Thresholdyn is not for everyone. Do not take Thresholdyn if you are allergic to Thresholdyn, doorways, or knowing things. Side effects may include: remembering things you had preferred to forget, knowing why you're in every room all the time, an inability to wander, spontaneous errand completion, and telling people what you actually came over to say. In rare cases, users have remembered why they got married. Do not operate a hallway until you know how Thresholdyn affects you. If you experience a sense of purpose lasting more than four hours, that's the intended effect. Ask your doctor if remembering is right for you.
Thresholdyn. Walk in like you mean it.
